_comment: THE single source of truth for every network fact an installer must emit.
This file exists because these values are now consumed by TWO implementations —
adna_install.py (Unix) and install.ps1 (Windows) — and hand-copying them into a second
language is exactly how a blocklist once shipped with four of its five entries.
A conformance test can only detect that kind of drift after it happens; a shared file
prevents it. Neither implementation may inline any value that belongs here.
The blocklist is the UNION across the master's two instances, which share one CA.
Neither instance alone carries all five (S347 §3) — shipping one instance's list is the bug.
nebula sha256 values were OBSERVED from the published SHASUM256.txt on 2026-08-16,
then INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED on 2026-08-21 (Phase C1) -- see nebula.provenance below.
An asset with no entry here must be REFUSED, never installed unverified.
Phase C1 (research_security_2026-08 item 1): the trust-on-first-observation pins
above were re-verified against upstream evidence at pin-audit time, and that
verification is recorded here so an auditor does not have to take the pins on faith.

shasum256_txt.result: all 5 pinned hashes match upstream exactly

live_redownload.result: sha256 of freshly downloaded bytes == pinned e7cdb240...

_comment: Gangway A3: the code flow. endpoint_url is the adna-enroll worker (empty until the
operator deploys it -- with it empty, --code falls back to the paste flow with a clear
message; ADNA_ENROLL_URL overrides for tests). ca_fingerprint is the trust anchor for
received certificates: it ships INSIDE the pinned installer payload, kubeadm-style, so
a compromised endpoint can queue garbage but can never redirect a node onto a different
CA. VERIFIED 2026-08-18 against a live mesh node's /etc/nebula/ca.crt (Lattice Mesh CA,
notAfter 2028-04-04) AND the S175 MEMBERSHIP_CERT_ISSUED ledger event -- both agree.

workspace._comment: Mirrors aDNA.aDNA/site/src/data/install_truth.json, which is generated by build_install_truth.mjs and is the site's single source for install commands. conformance_test.py C6 asserts these agree. Do not edit one without the other.
workspace.why_optional: Joining the network and having the aDNA workspace are separate goods. The mesh works with no workspace; the workspace is useful with no mesh. One installer offers both, neither requires the other, and NOTHING here requires Claude Code -- that was the point of unifying them.
